name: Amethyst
source:
Amethyst is a mutant shrouded in mystery, whose skin appears to be made of impenetrable diamonds, sparkling yet relentless as her fate. Her appearances are rare, almost legendary, but each time she brings disaster and misfortune. No one knows her true objectives, nor whether she acts of her own will or for a dark design, but her name is enough to make even the boldest tremble.

[In game description]
